provenance.citation: SantaLucia J Jr. A unified view of polymer, dumbbell, and oligonucleotide DNA nearest-neighbor thermodynamics. Proc Natl Acad Sci USA. 1998;95(4):1460-1465. Table 2, unified oligonucleotide ΔH° and ΔS° NN parameters in 1 M NaCl. Free full text: PMC19045.
provenance.licence: The article is free full text (PMC19045). The parameter values are published measurements transcribed from Table 2. CodonForge does not redistribute ViennaRNA or OligoAnalyzer parameter files.
provenance.notes: Table 2 initiation and symmetry rows are included. Eq. 3 gives Tm (R = 1.987 cal/K·mol). Eq. 7's published slope, -0.114 kcal/mol, is salt_dg37_kcal_per_ln_na. Entropy salt correction is that slope converted at 310.15 K with ΔH treated as salt-independent, which is the assumption stated for Eqs. 8 and 3. Hairpin loop initiation is not in Table 2 and is not invented here. source_digest is the sha256 of the PMC19045 HTML page the table was transcribed from on 2026-10-05.
